messages:
morgan: Creating follow-up thread for AureliusCorp postmortem — root doc linked in incident INC-2026-0419. Need to track ownership, timelines, and a concrete test plan for future peering flaps.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0419 created by morgan. Severity: P2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0419
sam: quick recap: outage triggered by median of two failures — flaky BGP session on customer edge + our peering-controller dropping routes when tag-drift detected. net effect: tenant isolation for ~27m.
anya: adding context: customer runs an older on-prem firewall that resets TCP sessions under SYN flood conditions; we saw BGP flaps correlate with their firewall logs.
leo: from runtime side, peering-controller had a guard that removed learned routes if private-tags mismatch. that guard behaved aggressively when our reconciliation backlog hit >500 ops.
morgan: Action items (proposed): 1) Sam to own short-term mitigations with customer (temporary hold-open BGP timers) — due 2026-04-30. 2) Leo to implement a soft-fail mode in peering-controller so route removal is gated — due 2026-05-14. 3) Anya to coordinate with Aurelius infra to schedule graded config changes and test window — due 2026-04-28.
sam: ack, I'll ping Aurelius infra today and propose the BGP-timer change. added to my calendar.
anya: I'll draft the test window email and run a connectivity checklist with them. will include steps to capture tcpdump + firewall logs.
leo: working on a PR for soft-fail mode. rough plan: when reconciliation backlog > threshold, mark controller in "observe-only" for route pruning for 10m, emit metric peering.controller.prune_softfail. sending RFC by EOD.
sre-tl: please add automated regression test that simulates a noisy edge (SYN flood/BGP resets) so we don't regress. include both unit-level sim and an infra-level chaos test in staging.
sam: draft of short-term mitigation that I'll propose to customer: set bgp keepalive 30 / holdtime 90 -> 60/180, and temporarily disable firewall strict-syn-protection for peering CIDRs. will capture acceptance criteria: no flap >5m in two consecutive hours.
morgan: Good. Also want a recurring check: weekly peering-health report for next 8 weeks for this customer (routes, BGP session uptime, peering-controller prune counts). who can own automation?
leo: I can add export to the peering-monitoring job to include prune counts and tag-drift metrics. estimate 4 days.
anya: I'll take the weekly coordination email and make sure the customer gives access to firewall logs for 2 weeks after the change.
sre-tl: Ownership summary: Sam (customer mitigations) | Leo (controller soft-fail + monitoring) | Anya (customer coordination + logs) | Morgan (inc owner + exec updates). Please add JIRA tasks under INC-2026-0419 and link PRs.
morgan: I'll create the JIRA tasks now and set due dates as above. Also scheduling a 30min follow-up sync next Tue 10am PT.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch leos/peering-softfail. Build #872 status: running.
sam: one more note — add a canary in Dedicated for similar customers: a small cross-account peering with synthetic traffic every 5m to detect route blackholing faster. I can prototype.
morgan: agreed. Add that as optional work (low effort, high signal).
leo: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/peering-soft-fail — comments welcome.
morgan: thanks all. I'll update the incident doc with owners + timeline + this thread link. please mark done in JIRA when tasks close. :thumbsup:
